CHAPTER 8 · ITEM 13 / 13

Tax size, time and subsidies

Subsidy versus ceiling補貼與價格上限

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Compare a subsidy and a binding price ceiling in terms of price, quantity, shortage and government spending; allow for market failures or other stated assumptions when evaluating policy.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

上限降低合法價格但造成短缺；補貼可同時降低買方價、提高賣方淨收及交易量，但要政府支出。政策評價取決於外部性、配給與財政假設。

A binding ceiling lowers the allowed price but restricts trade through shortage. A subsidy can lower buyer price while raising seller receipts and quantity, at a fiscal cost. Evaluate welfare using the stated externalities, allocation and government budget.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：Rent ceiling discourages supply; a per-unit housing subsidy can encourage more supply while lowering tenant price. It requires funding. 租客便宜但兩種政策供給誘因不同。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Which typically requires direct government spending per unit traded? 何者通常每交易一單位需政府付款？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
